proposed_urls.rationale: Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.011 Purpose - legislative declaration framing the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.021 Administration - administering authority for the lobbying-disclosure statute.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.031 Powers and duties - administering authority's powers and duties under the lobbying-disclosure statute.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.041 Registration; disqualification - core lobbyist registration provision.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.051 Reports - core lobbyist activity/expenditure reporting provision.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.061 Reports by employers of lobbyists - employer-side reporting obligation.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.071 Certification of reports - certification requirement for filed reports.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.081 Reporting periods - reporting period specification for lobbyist disclosures.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.091 Publication of reports - publication rules for disclosed reports.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.101 Public records - public-records status of disclosed reports.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.111 Preservation of records - record-retention requirement for lobbyist disclosures.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.116 Disclosure of contributions - lobbyist contribution disclosure obligation.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.121 Prohibitions - prohibited lobbyist conduct.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.131 Examination of statements, reports - enforcement examination of filed disclosures.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.135 Administrative complaints - administrative complaint procedure for disclosure violations.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.141 Civil penalty: Late registration, filing of required statements or reports - civil penalty for late disclosure filings.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.151 Criminal penalties - criminal penalties for disclosure violations.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.161 Exemptions - exemptions from the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.171 Definitions - definitions used throughout the lobbying-disclosure chapter.
Ch. 24.45 sec 24.45.181 Short title - short title for the Regulation of Lobbying Act.

notes: Single-regime state: AS 24.45 (Regulation of Lobbying) under Title 24 (Legislature and Lobbying). Tree depth is 4 (state -> title -> chapter -> article -> section), one level deeper than the canonical 3-pass schema; added 5 intermediate article-level fetches via the pass3 label after the chapter-24.45 pass3 fetch revealed an article-level TOC rather than section leaves. Filename collisions avoided because the helper derives the filename stem from the last URL segment (chapter-24.45 vs article-01..05). Repealed sections (10 total, marked '[Repealed, Sec. 1 ch 167 SLA 1976]') are excluded from proposed_urls per the prompt's high-precision-over-high-recall guidance - they carry no current statutory content. 20 live section URLs proposed (17 core + 3 support). No Playwright/Cloudflare errors. The AK 2010 canary returned 45 URLs likely because it counted article-TOC pages and/or repealed-section leaves; this AK 2015 result keeps the same statute body but trims to live-content leaves only.
